newsitem.title: UK: Gilts hit new contract high as UK budget starts.
newsitem.headline: Gilts hit new contract high as UK budget starts.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE set a new contract high above 115-02 on Wednesday as Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown began Labour's first budget speech in 18 years.
By 1454 GMT, September gilts were up 16/32 at 115-04, punching past the old contract high of 115-02 set earlier in the day.
Brown said he aimed to promote long term fiscal stability in the budget and also announced a five year deficit reduction plan.
